task: Browse used Mercedes-Benz cars from model years 2004 to 2012 on KBB and sort by highest price.
agent_final_answer:
Completed: Browsed used Mercedes-Benz cars (model years 2004-2012) on KBB.com and sorted by highest price.

Steps performed:
1. Went to Cars for Sale, opened Filters.
2. Set Year range: Min Year 2004, Max Year 2012.
3. Set Make = Mercedes-Benz (Make, Model & Trim filter).
4. Applied filters -> 59 matches near ZIP 94014 (Daly City, CA), page titled "Mercedes-Benz Cars for Sale".
5. Set Sort By = "Price - Highest".

4) 2010 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500, 79K mi - $25,900
5) 2009 Mercedes-Benz SL 550, 75K mi - $19,998
6) 2012 Mercedes-Benz E 350 Cabriolet, 65K mi - $19,188

The highest-priced used Mercedes-Benz in the 2004-2012 range is the 2012 Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG Wagon at $57,000.
